block_set.why_not_contiguous: layers 2..37 are listed in checkpoints/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.safetensors.index.json but their shards were never acquired (README.md §Download, D-03's sampled audit). The chain is therefore layer0 -> layer1 -> layer38 -> layer39, and a record read as 'the activation after layer 37' would be wrong: layer38.input is layer1's output, not the model's post-layer-37 state.

input.method: torch.randint over the first 100k vocabulary rows from a private torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed); structural ids (config bos/eos, 248046, 248068, 248069) are excluded by assertion. The rows are the real embed_tokens slice, sha-witnessed against a second independent read of the shard.

stage_source.x: forward PRE-hook on the decoder layer's input (== input_layernorm's input)
stage_source.h_in: forward hook on input_layernorm's output (§03.2 step 1)
stage_source.mixer_out: forward hook on linear_attn/self_attn's output (§03.2 step 2)
stage_source.x1: forward PRE-hook on post_attention_layernorm's input (§03.2 step 3's addend pair)
stage_source.h_mlp: forward hook on post_attention_layernorm's output (§03.2 step 4)
stage_source.moe_out: forward hook on mlp's output (§03.2 step 5)
stage_source.out: the decoder layer's return value (§03.2 step 6)

reading_rules.payload: raw little-endian element bytes, no header; bytes == elements x itemsize, and `--mode verify` refuses a record whose size cannot hold its own declared shape (pitfalls/30 §Read a dump's dtype off its file size). Same contract as checkpoints/dump-manifest-2026-10-26.json.
reading_rules.bf16: two bytes per element, bit image — read with a uint16 view then bitcast, never cast the uint16 to a float (pitfalls/30)
reading_rules.chaining: each record's `input_from` names the predecessor FILE and its sha256; the chain is auditable from this manifest alone, not assumed
reading_rules.contiguous: `contiguous: false` on a record means NO record in this manifest may be read as a true model activation while any layer is missing; it is a global property, deliberately the same on every record so no reader can pick a row and assume it is contiguous. The per-hop truth is `chain_gap.layers_between_missing`: [] means the predecessor is the immediately preceding layer (layer0->layer1, layer38->layer39), a list means the predecessor is NOT the previous layer and the activation is missing those layers' transformations.
reading_rules.authority: these are reference activations from the installed transformers reference under the acquired bf16 weights, not engine output. They license nothing by themselves: a band over a chained row needs its own floor probe (D-25 guard 7).
